name: orc_void_fraction_charge
title: Low-temperature ORC (R134a) with void-fraction charge of the heat exchangers
summary: Low-temperature R134a Rankine cycle (ULiège lab model, 2007): pump, three-zone evaporator and condenser weighted by the refrigerant mass per zone, detailed expander (throat pressure drop, leakage, isochoric expansion, cooling); the refrigerant charge M_charge is solved from a global void-fraction balance so that the condenser subcooling is met.

authors: TBD (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory; comments signed ARA)

verification.summary: Compared with the EES stored solution: cycle results within 9.3e-04 (M_charge 5.6e-04), max 8.0e-03 on the evaporator zone shares (glycol-water backend); absolute h/s carry a constant reference offset, differences within 6e-04.
verification.reference: EES stored solution shipped in the source file (298/299 valid values), tools/compare_solution.py
verification.notes: Native file vs EES: 293 common variables; excluding the absolute h/s (constant EES-CoolProp reference offset, differences within 6e-04) and X_ex_* (0 vs EES +/-100, CS-GAP-QUALITY-DOME, diagnostic only), max 8.0e-03 (omega_vapor_ev), 7.2e-03 on M_dot_sf_ev/C_dot_sf_ev (glycol-water backend); M_charge 5.6e-04, W_dot_Rankine 9.3e-04, rho_sf_cd 3.2e-04. The earlier comparison was made with a runnable variant (rho_sf_cd = (1+w)/Volume, 1.1994 kg/m3, max 1.2e-02).
